transcript:a2c58468c56f19a9db6a44a346e1b:
Lena: Hi Katrin, Lena from SD Worx. Good weekend?
Katrin: Lovely, thanks, finally some sun! So, a few payroll updates.
Katrin: From next month, the payroll cutoff for Nike Deutschland GmbH moves from the fifteenth to the twentieth.
Lena: The twentieth, noted.
Katrin: And bonus changes need approval from the Betriebsrat first, our works council.
Lena: Who knows that process best?
Katrin: Jonas handled that approval last year.
Lena: Perfect. Thanks Katrin, have a great week!
Katrin: You too, bye!
